flatten_tree_with_names: flatten a JAX pytree into a list of (name, value) pairs with path-like leaf names
map_tree_with_regex: apply a function to tree leaves matching regex patterns with fallback for unmatched leaves
merge_checkpoint_params: merge loaded checkpoint parameters with initialized model parameters, handling missing and extra keys
broadcast_prefix_tree: broadcast a prefix pytree to match the structure of a target pytree
create_mask_trees: create boolean mask trees for each regex pattern to selectively filter tree leaves
